# jumpcloud_authentication_policy (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud authentication policy for conditional access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Require MFA for user portal logins from outside the office IP list.
resource "jumpcloud_authentication_policy" "portal_mfa" {
  name     = "User Portal MFA Outside Office"
  type     = "user_portal"
  disabled = false

  conditions = {
    ip_address_not_in = [jumpcloud_ip_list.office.id]
  }

  effect = {
    action              = "allow"
    mfa_required        = true
    mfa_allowed_factors = ["totp", "webauthn", "push"]
  }
}

# Deny access to an application from untrusted devices.
resource "jumpcloud_authentication_policy" "app_trusted_devices" {
  name = "Finance App Trusted Devices Only"
  type = "resource"

  conditions = {
    device_trusted = false
  }

  effect = {
    action = "deny"
  }

  targets = [
    {
      type = "application"
      id   = jumpcloud_application.finance.id
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the authentication policy.
- `type` (String) The policy type (e.g. user_portal, resource).

### Optional

- `conditions` (Attributes) Conditions that determine when this policy applies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is disabled.
- `effect` (Attributes) The effect when the policy conditions are met. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effect))
- `targets` (Attributes List) Target resources this policy applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the authentication policy.

<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Optional:

- `device_trusted` (Boolean) Whether the device must be trusted.
- `geo_ip_in` (List of String) Country codes the request must originate from.
- `geo_ip_not_in` (List of String) Country codes the request must not originate from.
- `ip_address_in` (List of String) IP list IDs that the request IP must match.
- `ip_address_not_in` (List of String) IP list IDs that the request IP must not match.


<a id="nestedatt--effect"></a>
### Nested Schema for `effect`

Required:

- `action` (String) The action to take: allow or deny.

Optional:

- `mfa_allowed_factors` (List of String) Allowed MFA factor types (e.g. totp, webauthn, push).
- `mfa_required` (Boolean) Whether MFA is required.


<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Required:

- `id` (String) The target resource ID.
- `type` (String) The target resource type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_authentication_policy.example <policy-id>
```
